newsitem.title: USA: Canadian spot domestic natgas firms, exports hold.
newsitem.headline: Canadian spot domestic natgas firms, exports hold.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices extended their gains in Alberta Tuesday amid warmer weather, market sources said.
Spot gas at Alberta's AECO storage hub was quoted at C$1.51-1.52 per gigajoule, up from C$1.46-1.47 on Monday.
Temperature highs in Calgary were expected to hover around 80 degrees F over the next couple of days, according to Weather Services Corp.
Traders also blamed the price uptick on hefty storage buying in Alberta.
At Sumas, Wash., prices held around $1.10 per million British thermal units (mmBtu), with temperature highs in the Northwest mostly in the low-to-mid 80s F.
In the East, prices at Niagara also remained firm at $2.29 per mmBtu, supported by a rally on NYMEX to a high of $2.135 for August, up five cents.
